notes: kb/Work PB5242 landed. §1985:X.4.4.2 is the RD with [IS GLOBAL] and the Report Writer clauses. The PAGE clause's 2002 additions (the page width, integer-1 omitted, LAST CONTROL HEADING, DE/CH, IS before a phrase's integer) are report-page-forms-2002 and CODE IS is report-code-is-2002, each refused at 85. `PAGE IS 20 LINES` is COBOL-85: only PAGE is underlined in the bracket `[LIMIT IS | LIMITS ARE]` (§1985:XIII.3.8.2, the PDF page rendered), so it is not refused. Witnesses: 1985-FMT-X_4_4_2, pb5242-page-forms-85 and pb5242-code-is-85. Each 2002 form is refused at --std 85 with COBOL0900 by a construct row of the version matrix (tests/version-matrix/constructs/report-*-2002.json, introducedIn 2002), checked on recognition in VersionConformancePass's parse arm, and accepted from COBOL-2002 (ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 115).
